description:
You are the Office Manager at Northwind Traders. The financial year 2024 has ended, and you need to secure the data and update document standards for 2025.

1. Set the system **Lock Date** to **31/12/2024** (December 31, 2024) to prevent changes to past records.
2. Configure the **Form Defaults** for **Sales Invoices**. Update the **Footer** field to include the new 2025 payment terms exactly as follows:

Payment Terms: Net 15 Days.
Bank: First National Bank
Account: 555-0199
Thank you for your business!

Navigate to Settings to perform these tasks.
